title: Llama Cadmies Knowledge Base
definition: A comprehensive text knowledge base, built for and by the LLama model, which serves as the source of information for the fine-tuning process.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of it as a large library that contains a wealth of information used to train an AI model to provide accurate and informed answers.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The LLama Cadmies knowledge base is a vast repository of structured data that serves as the foundation for the fine-tuning of the LLama model, providing it with the necessary context and information for specific tasks.
difficulty_levels.expert: The LLama Cadmies knowledge base represents a crucial component in the fine-tuning process, as it allows the model to learn from a diverse range of domains and concepts, thereby improving its performance and generalization capabilities.

extra_fields.insight: The novel insight here is the creation of a usable, knowledgeable, in-character AI librarian who embodies the project's accumulated knowledge.
